safety-n1.text: Authenticator. Shows the sealed vault (unlock with a passphrase; try a wrong one, the right one is correct horse), entries with large grouped codes, a countdown ring with a seconds number, the next-code peek, search with the .* regex toggle, reorder, the add routes and the export choices. Try: search, Up, the add tabs, Export secrets in clear text. Unbuilt here: real codes, the two-key confirmation and the QR and Clock check panels, which the app has.

safety-n2.text: QR pairing. Shows the parameters, a generated secret, the QR (an illustration here; the app draws the real one with its own encoder, black on white with a quiet zone), the secret behind an explicit reveal, and the typed-back code that arms Save. Try: Show the secret as text, a wrong code, then 474596. Unbuilt: camera scanning, which needs a platform barcode reader the app does not have, so it says so and offers paste.

safety-n3.text: Element locks. Shows a locked element, the non-modal wizard beside it (six policies, credentials, duration, the toy-lock disclosure and recovery folder) and the unlock prompt with keypad and manual entry on one check. Try: the locked Runners button, the four wizard steps, a wrong PIN five times, then 2468. Unbuilt here: TOTP pairing inside the wizard and the real attempt budget, which the app keeps in its main process.

safety-n4.text: Unlock ladder. Shows the four rungs in order (dim sum, ten sums, whack-a-mole, the clock), the hourly skip budget and School mode starting at the sums with the dim sum rung absent. Try: pick dishes, Submit all ten, hit the raised hole, switch School mode. Unbuilt here: main-process grading with single-use nonces and expiry, which the app has.

safety-n5.text: Support Tickets. Shows the plain disclosure line outside the comedy, the resolution with the exact folder path, Open the folder and Copy, the ticket form with a severity nobody honours, and a searchable list whose status advances with canned replies. Try: Submit ticket, Check for updates, search. Unbuilt here: export, bulk delete through the two-key confirmation and real folder opening, which the app has.
